messages:
alex: Morning — async check-in. Quick status:
• Did: landed kernel patch to add a prefetch sampling toggle (PREFETCH_SAMPLING env). Also tightened the KV eviction threshold heuristic.
• Blocker: seeing a 95th-latency spike on canary when microbatch size >= 16 (tail goes from ~35ms -> ~50ms). KV hit-rate dips around the same time.
• Today: run a sweep across slot sizes (4/8/16), prefetch on/off, and collect heatmaps for eviction; review maya's causal-batching PR. Pinging @maya @sam for bench help.

maya: Thanks — yes I'll review the PR today. I reworked causal batching to avoid cross-slot mixing (PR link in code-review). Noted the mem climb during warmup you mentioned earlier. I'll add a small memprof run to the PR checklist. Can we get a reproducible bench harness?

sam: I'm on it. Running a focused bench now against canary pool-3. Quick log snippet:
```
bench --seq 2048 --burst 100 --batch-size 16
baseline 95th=35.2ms
canary   95th=52.1ms
kv_hit_rate: baseline 87.4% -> canary 85.2%
```
Repro step I used above — pushing full output to perf bucket.

infra-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T09:12 completed on pool-3 (3/5 nodes ready).

alex: thx sam. Can you upload the bench tarball and paste the link? Also try toggling PREFETCH_SAMPLING=0 to see if prefetch is the trigger. If that drops tail we'll know it's prefetch-related.

sam: uploaded: https://perf.redwood/snapshots/bench-4312345678
Quick comparisons from the run:
• prefetch=on 95th=51.8ms
• prefetch=off 95th=38.6ms
KV hit-rate recovered ~+1.6% with prefetch off. Looks correlated.

maya: Interesting. I'll try repro with KV warmup disabled and run the memprof. If prefetch is pushing extra KV entries or growing prefetched prefixes it could cause more eviction churn. I'll add an opt-out flag in the PR so operators can toggle without full redeploy.

alex: Plan for today: 1) run sweep (slot sizes 4/8/16) with prefetch on/off and collect eviction heatmaps + tail latency; 2) triage PR comments from maya; 3) if we need more signal, bump canary to 10 nodes and run larger bursts. Blocker: need approval to temporarily increase canary quota. @nora — can you approve a +5 nodes bump for 2 hours? :pray:

nora: Approved. Raised quota +5 nodes for 2 hours. :white_check_mark: Starting scale at 10:45 PT.

sam: I'll run the slot-sweep at 11:00 PT and post the raw CSV + summary. If anyone wants to pair on analysis ping me.

maya: I'll attach the memprof and a small reproducer harness to the PR. Tagging @alex for final review once tests are added.

infra-bot: perf-alert: rolling_compaction detected 2 OOMs during canary window 09:15-09:45. Ticket created INC-3982.

alex: Noted — investigating OOM stack traces now, suspect prefetch memory growth during warmup. If OOMs continue we'll trigger fallback to older model variant per routing policy. I'll post debug artifacts to the ticket.

sam: Posted experiment results: slot=4 (prefetch on) 95th=40ms; slot=8 95th=44ms; slot=16 95th=51ms. Prefetch off reduces slot=16 to 39ms. Attaching CSV.

maya: Good signal. I think short-term mitigation is adding the opt-out flag + lowering prefetch aggressiveness for microburst workloads. I'll sketch the change.

alex: Great. If everyone is aligned, I'll merge the kernel toggle (small change) after maya's opt-out lands and we get a clean canary run. Thanks all — ping if you see more anomalies.

nora: Canary scaled up and experiments completed. Will monitor infra metrics for next 2 hours and report any further anomalies.

alex: closing loop — reviewer ask: focus on eviction threshold diff in kernel/core.cc lines ~200-230 when reviewing. I'll add inline notes. Cheers.
